## Project identity
**Descriptive name:** **Hands-On 5G Standalone Testbed Operation And Troubleshooting Repository**
A focused 5G Standalone testbed repository. The runbook documents a working stack composed of Open5GS core network functions, an srsRAN gNB, a USRP B210 radio and a Quectel modem on n78/TDD. It covers service startup, gNB/core attachment, forced NR5G mode, NSA-fallback control, registration verification, PDU-session establishment and data-plane checks. This is strong direct evidence of 5G-SA testbed integration and troubleshooting, not implementation of the 3GPP protocol stack.
Correct classification:
> **hands-on 5G Standalone testbed operation and troubleshooting repository.**

## 56. Repository 120 bottom line
**Repository 120 `5G-SA` is best understood as hands-on 5G Standalone testbed operation and troubleshooting repository.**
A focused 5G Standalone testbed repository. The runbook documents a working stack composed of Open5GS core network functions, an srsRAN gNB, a USRP B210 radio and a Quectel modem on n78/TDD. It covers service startup, gNB/core attachment, forced NR5G mode, NSA-fallback control, registration verification, PDU-session establishment and data-plane checks. This is strong direct evidence of 5G-SA testbed integration and troubleshooting, not implementation of the 3GPP protocol stack.
**Product/engineering maturity:** 4.0/5.
**Portfolio Evidence Weight:** 5.0/5.
### Strongest defensible claims
- 5G Standalone testbed operation — 4.9/5 (direct)
- Open5GS core-network operation — 4.7/5 (direct)
- srsRAN gNB operation — 4.6/5 (direct)
- USRP B210 SDR integration — 4.5/5 (direct)
- Quectel AT/QMI modem operation — 4.8/5 (direct)
- 5G registration/PDU-session troubleshooting — 4.8/5 (direct)
### Critical caveats
- implementation of Open5GS or srsRAN protocol stacks
- commercial RAN deployment
- carrier-grade availability
- RF conformance/certification testing
- runbook procedures are environment/version sensitive
- testbed service order and configuration coupling can cause brittle failures
- subscriber/config identifiers are sensitive and must not be reproduced
### Career effect
This is a major telecommunications milestone: the corpus now has direct, dedicated evidence of operating a complete 5G-SA lab path from core network through gNB/SDR to UE registration and data plane. It becomes the corpus maximum for hands-on cellular testbed integration at this point.

sections.content:
- 5G Standalone testbed operation — 4.9/5 (direct)

- srsRAN gNB operation — 4.6/5 (direct)

sections.title: Critical caveats
sections.content:
- implementation of Open5GS or srsRAN protocol stacks
- commercial RAN deployment
- carrier-grade availability
- RF conformance/certification testing
- runbook procedures are environment/version sensitive
- testbed service order and configuration coupling can cause brittle failures
- subscriber/config identifiers are sensitive and must not be reproduced

sections.title: Career effect
sections.content: This is a major telecommunications milestone: the corpus now has direct, dedicated evidence of operating a complete 5G-SA lab path from core network through gNB/SDR to UE registration and data plane. It becomes the corpus maximum for hands-on cellular testbed integration at this point.

# Repository 120 / 134 — `5G-SA`
## Project identity
**Descriptive name:** **Hands-On 5G Standalone Testbed Operation And Troubleshooting Repository**
A focused 5G Standalone testbed repository. The runbook documents a working stack composed of Open5GS core network functions, an srsRAN gNB, a USRP B210 radio and a Quectel modem on n78/TDD. It covers service startup, gNB/core attachment, forced NR5G mode, NSA-fallback control, registration verification, PDU-session establishment and data-plane checks.
